context_requirements: Expression of AGTR2 or other angiotensin receptors; most lines lack functional angiotensin receptor signaling
An intact renin-angiotensin system or angiotensin-responsive transcriptional program
Presence of angiotensin II or related peptides to antagonize
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is not explained by generic stress or proliferation
Evidence of AGTR2-mediated signaling in these lines

evidence.supports: Angiotensin II can regulate gene expression (proenkephalin) in adrenal medullary cells, but the effect is slow (12-24 h) and requires angiotensin receptor signaling; no evidence for a direct transcriptional response in the tested cell lines.
